process.name: Merit Excellence Scholarship
process.description: Fictional scholarship used for the FlowForge demo. No real program.

workflow.goal: I want to apply for the Merit Excellence Scholarship

states.label: Eligibility
states.description: Verifying eligibility against the applicant profile.

states.label: Not Eligible
states.description: The applicant does not satisfy the eligibility requirements.

states.label: Documents
states.description: Upload your academic transcript, government ID, income certificate and personal essay.

states.label: Validation
states.description: AI-assisted cross-document validation of extracted fields.

states.label: Resolve Warning
states.description: A potential eligibility issue was detected. Acknowledge to continue, or reject to correct your documents.

states.label: Blocked
states.description: Validation failed fatally. No submission will be attempted.

states.label: Approval
states.description: Human approval is required before submission. Nothing is submitted without your explicit consent.

states.label: Cancelled
states.description: Submission was declined by the user.

states.label: Submission
states.description: Submitting the assembled application (simulated in demo).
